prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Frozen P01-K02, ONE standalone edge-to-edge scene, no page or collage. Exact crop input 1 governs pose/moment, page input 2 and portrait/costume inputs 3/4 govern identity. Inside the tilted silver/teal passenger carriage, Illuminara braces her RIGHT hand against the seat at image-left and reaches her LEFT arm protectively across a mother in a burgundy coat and her small child in a red scarf at image-right. Mother holds child close. They are frightened and off balance, no evacuation yet. Illuminara has olive skin, hazel eyes, dark curls raised in a loose bun, loose tendrils, small crystal earrings/pendant, ivory wrap tunic and flowing trousers with gold embroidery and gold belt, pale boots. No new superhero costume, no glowing shield yet. Keep source's gaze toward mother/child, coherent normal hands and two arms only. Navy seats, silver poles, warm ceiling lamps, city outside tilted windows. Painterly modern graphic novel realism, clear contours, warm sunlight and cool navy shadows. Reserve a small quiet roof area upper-left for later lettering. Clean art: NO text, bubble, caption, sound-effect, letters, watermark or border. Portrait 9:16 phone staging: her braced crouch in centre-left, protective forearm spans to mother/child in centre-right; vertical aisle depth and her flowing trouser leg extend downward. Headroom above them, all three faces, acting hands and balance support remain fully in frame. A fresh vertical composition with useful floor/ceiling depth, never a crop or padded landscape.
